forcompanies.title: For companies
forcompanies.heading: Meet the students of Electronic Systems Design and Innovation
forcompanies.lead: E&T-dagene is a yearly career fair at NTNU Gløshaugen, run by students of Electronic Systems Design and Innovation (ELSYS).

signup.title: Sign-up and prices
signup.text: Send us an email for information about sign-up and prices.

arrival.title: Arrival
arrival.text: The nearest drop-off by car is the south side of Frimerket, the lawn just behind the Main Building.

stand.title: Your stand
stand.text: In Glassgården in the EL building. We help you set it up.

presentation.title: Company presentation
presentation.text: We book the lecture hall and promote your presentation beforehand.

speed.title: Speedbedpress
speed.text: Short presentations one after another, about you and the summer jobs you offer.

interviews.title: Interviews
interviews.text: Rooms for interviews during the fair and the day after.

after.title: Afterwards
after.text: A year's access to the resumes students upload.

allday.label: All day
allday.food: Food and drink for everyone from your company

audience.heading: Who you meet
audience.intro: ELSYS combines electronics, circuit design, physics and signal processing, with hands-on projects from the first year.

field.acoustics: Acoustics for communication, environment and remote sensing
field.analog: Analogue circuit design and radio engineering
field.digital: Design of digital and embedded systems

audience.venue: The fair is held in Glassgården in the EL building, next to one of the three largest lecture halls at Gløshaugen and several reading and lecture rooms, so many students pass through. You also meet students from cybernetics and energy and environmental engineering, among others.
audience.promoted: We promote the fair to students beforehand.

help.q: What do you help us with?
help.a: We help you with the stand, the company presentation, and interviews or speed interviews.

equipment.a: Beyond what your contract includes, you can order extra equipment, such as tables, standing tables, coffee or TV screens. Email bedriftansvarlig{'@'}et-dagen.no.

talk.title: Be easy to talk to
talk.text: Open body language and real interest make it easier for students to approach you. Ask questions and listen.

jobs.title: Make your jobs easy to find
jobs.text: Many students look for a summer job, an internship or a permanent job. A clear QR code to your job ads makes it easy to apply afterwards.

space.title: Take up space
space.text: Students stop at stands they can see and hear. Keep the stand open, so it invites conversation.

remembered.title: Be remembered
remembered.text: A small giveaway, a good conversation or a fun activity makes students remember you after the fair.

follow.title: Follow up
follow.text: If you meet students who are especially interested, ask them to get in touch.

closing.heading: Questions, or ready to take part?
closing.text: Our corporate relations contact answers everything about sign-up, prices and equipment.
